China's Xi Calls for Party Adaptability Amid Global Shifts

Chinese President Xi Jinping has urged the Communist Party to be adaptable and safeguard its advances in a rapidly changing world. The call comes as China navigates complex relationships with other nations, including the US and Taiwan. This shift in tone suggests a desire to maintain stability while embracing change.
